_metadata.description: OT-P1-002 — per-plan velocity emitted as a signal, plus the plan supersession/dependency graph.

requirements.title: Track per-plan velocity and emit it to meta-optimization trials
requirements.description: Capture per-plan velocity (wall-time + tokens + iterations to complete; full vs partial) as a historical signal and emit it to meta-optimization-manager trials, so plan throughput becomes a measurable local-model-readiness input.

validation.notes: Completion captures local velocity and emits it through the velocity sink seam.

requirements.title: Maintain a plan supersession/dependency graph and per-surface templates
requirements.description: Track supersession/dependency edges between plans (using the stored content hash) and provide per-surface plan templates (CLI/proto/UI) so a new plan starts pre-scaffolded for its surface.

validation.notes: Matching content hashes derive supersession edges.
Dependency links are first-class graph edges.
Per-surface templates seed structured plan phases.

requirements.title: The Plan Manager should preserve related plans in a durable reviewed family aggregate.
requirements.description: When an operator groups independently executable plans under one initiative, the Plan Manager should round-trip the shared outcome, context, unchanged child-plan identities, typed claims, graph revisions, and immutable review decisions.

validation.notes: The production SQLite repository and service round-trip the aggregate, graph, and review without changing child identity metadata.

requirements.title: If a family graph is unsafe or unreviewed, then the Plan Manager should withhold a launchable frontier.
requirements.description: If a graph contains a cycle, dangling member, overlapping exclusive claim, unresolved interaction, stale revision, or missing review, then the Plan Manager should return typed diagnostics and should not co-schedule the unsafe plans; independent plans should remain eligible after an unrelated dependency failure.

validation.notes: The service rejects dangling edges, cyclic approval, and stale optimistic writes.
Deterministic generated DAGs prove dependencies and conflicts never share a batch.
A failed prerequisite blocks reachable dependents without suppressing independent work.

requirements.title: When agents discover plan judgment, Prompt Manager shall resolve each stable public name to one Plan Manager-owned source.
requirements.description: Plan Manager owns implementation-plan-authoring, implementation-plan-execution, plan-family-orchestration, and plan-manager-improve. Registry projection preserves the public names and rejects duplicate authoritative sources.

validation.notes: The repository-wide ratchet rejects any skill id that exists in both a scenario-owned source and a Prompt Manager pack.
